entities.name: Annie La Fleur
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Annie Lilian La Fleur is an Australian-Papua New Guinean former basketball player who competed in the 2000 Summer Olympics and the WNBA from 1999 to 2003. She also played for the Sydney Flames in the WNBL, the Australian domestic competition.
